verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is a code-first Python framework, so its programmatic API is the primary surface. The same agent object can be called with run(), launched as a CLI via to_cli_sync(), or served as a browser chat UI through clai, and evals are defined entirely in Python. Its optional UI surfaces therefore sit on top of the API rather than adding capabilities the API lacks. Missing for 10: no explicit documented statement of UI/API feature parity, unclear scope of the probed openapi.json, and no independent hands-on corroboration that the browser chat UI exposes nothing beyond the API.
